anti_overclaim: The formula is frozen only for declared finite-group equivariant selector problems; nonlinear/multi-endpoint mechanisms require their own typed group/feasibility proof.

exact_role.empty: no deterministic equivariant feasible selector exists on the orbit
exact_role.multiple: each filtered output gives an equivariant orbit selector, so the current context/constraints do not canonically choose among them
exact_role.singleton: the unique filtered output extends uniquely on the orbit
